synthesis: On the Scout admin org map (Bird's Eye, /scout/org-map), the bottom stat sheet (MapStatsBar.vue) shows Scans / Direct Live Hits / Staging Live Hits with no indication of WHOSE activity they represent. The backend is correct and needs no change: ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::stats() sums over scopedKits(), and scopedKits() returns ALL of the org's Scout kits when the client sends no kit_ids -- so the default numbers really are org-wide aggregates. The org map has THREE scope states, only ONE of which is labelled today: (a) nothing followed, nothing selected -> true org-wide aggregate [UNLABELLED], (b) a subset selected via DriverSelector, none followed -> filtered [UNLABELLED], (c) a driver followed -> already labelled by an existing crimson pill reading "Showing only {name}'s stats" (App.vue:92-96). Compounding it, MapStatsBar's four tile tooltips assert singular ownership unconditionally -- 'your kit read', 'Plates you scanned' -- which is literally false when an admin is reading an org-wide total. So this is FINISHING an existing mechanism, not building one: the fix is a client-only Vue label/copy change, gated on mapStore.adminMode so the driver PWA is untouched.

scope.summary: Client-only Vue label/copy change in resources/js/clarity-scout. Extend the existing adminMode scope pill in App.vue so every scope state is labelled (not just the followed-driver one), and make MapStatsBar's tile tooltip copy admin-aware so it stops claiming singular ownership of aggregated numbers. No backend, route, query, or schema change. Built assets must be rebuilt and committed.

questions.q: Exact wording and visual treatment for the aggregate label -- 'All Drivers' vs 'Aggregate' vs 'Org-wide', and should it be a persistent pill in the same slot/style as the existing crimson 'Showing only X's stats' pill?
questions.answer: "All Drivers". Treatment confirmed as offered: a persistent pill in the same slot as the existing "Showing only {name}'s stats" pill, but neutral grey rather than crimson -- crimson reads as "you are narrowed", and the aggregate state is the default.

questions.q: Does the subset-selected-but-not-followed state (e.g. 3 of 10 drivers picked in the Driver Selector) get its own label, or is 'All Drivers' vs 'Showing only X' the only distinction wanted?
questions.answer: Yes -- label all three scope states. The subset state gets its own label, e.g. "Showing 3 of 10 drivers". Same mechanism, closes the identical misreading risk.

questions.q: Is the MapStatsBar tooltip copy fix in this PR -- branching 'The total number of license plates your kit read...' / 'Plates you scanned...' on adminMode -- or label-only now and copy separately?
questions.answer: Yes -- fix the MapStatsBar tile tooltip copy in this PR. Branch the four description strings on adminMode using the DashboardOverlay ternary idiom. Driver surface copy stays exactly as-is.

questions.q: DashboardOverlay.vue:85-88 hardcodes "Org-wide hits that haven't been repossessed yet" whenever adminMode is true, even while a driver is followed or a subset is selected (recentHits is scoped by the same followedKitId/selectedKitIds via lib/fetch.js). That is the same bug pointing the other way. Fix it here, or a separate ticket?
questions.answer: Yes -- fix DashboardOverlay.vue:85-88 in this PR. Its Live Hits header must reflect the ACTUAL scope: the followed driver's name when following, and org-wide only when genuinely unfiltered.

questions.q: Is the backend aggregation itself correct, or does the ticket imply a change to WHAT is aggregated?
questions.answer: Correct and unchanged. scopedKits() returns all non-deleted org Scout kits when no kit_ids filter is supplied; stats()'s docblock and okf/concepts/scout-birds-eye.md both state this is intentional. Independently confirmed by all three prep candidates. This is purely a labelling gap, not a data-correctness bug.

questions.q: Does a scope label already exist, or must one be built from scratch?
questions.answer: One already exists for the followed-driver state only: App.vue:92-96, a crimson pill reading "Showing only {name}'s stats", driven by the followedDriverName computed at App.vue:344-353. The work is to extend it to the other two scope states, not to build a new indicator. DashboardOverlay.vue:85-88 supplies the established adminMode ternary idiom for the copy half.

notes: public/build is tracked (15 files). A Vue change MUST be followed by npm run build with the built assets committed, or the fix never reaches the served app.

Driver and admin Scout surfaces share App.vue and MapStatsBar.vue. MapStatsBar has NO adminMode branch today, so any copy fix must be conditional -- a blanket string replacement would break the driver surface, where 'your kit' is correct.

DashboardOverlay.vue:85-88 is BOTH the pattern to copy (correct adminMode ternary) AND itself incomplete (claims org-wide while possibly filtered). Candidates 2 and 3 saw the first; candidate 1 saw the second. Both readings are true; question 4 resolves the scope call.

No JS/Vue test runner exists (package.json has dev/build/test:e2e only; the single Playwright spec tests/e2e/gl-kits.spec.ts does not touch Scout). Repo memory also notes platform CI's lint_check_and_test runs only on main/deploy PRs, so a Scout PR gets no CI test run either way.
selectedKitIds and followedKitId are module-level refs exported from lib/adminScope.js, not Pinia state. Import them the way DriverSelector.vue and stores/map.js already do rather than re-deriving.

DriverSelector's 'select all' path resets selectedKitIds to null, so client-side the value is either null (true aggregate) or a strict subset -- never 'all, explicitly'. That makes the three-state branch a clean if/else-if/else with no boundary case.

Grep backstop returned 15 referencing files, overwhelmingly generic adminMode checks. The only one relevant to the plan is ScannerMap.vue (setFollowedDriver:794, clearFollowedDriver:313) -- the transitions between scope states, worth exercising in QA but not edited.

grounding.code_flow: Admin opens /scout/org-map -> ClarityScoutAdminMiddleware gate -> birdseye.js boots App.vue with adminMode=true -> App.vue always renders the expanded MapStatsBar (mapStore.adminMode || barExpanded) -> MapStatsBar reads useDashboardStore().stats -> dashboard.fetchStats() GETs /scout/org-map/api/dashboard/stats via lib/fetch.js buildUrl(), which auto-appends kit_ids[] from lib/adminScope.js (selectedKitIds / followedKitId; null = all) -> ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::stats() intersects the requested kit_ids with scopedKits() (absent = ALL org kits) -> sums ClickHouse scans_hot/cold + hits_hot/cold across them -> MapStatsBar renders the totals with unconditional driver-voiced copy, and App.vue shows a scope pill ONLY in the followed-driver state.

plan_sketch.intent: Open /scout/org-map as an org admin with nothing followed and no Driver Selector filter; confirm an aggregate / 'All Drivers' label is visible with the stat sheet.
Click a driver's live dot to follow them; confirm the existing "Showing only {name}'s stats" pill appears, the aggregate label disappears, and the numbers drop to that one kit.

Open the driver (non-admin) Scout PWA as a kit user; confirm no scope pill and unchanged 'your kit' / 'you scanned' tile copy.

Plus one org ADMIN user to reach /scout/org-map and one driver user for the non-admin regression check.
